title: Downstream LLM Provider Rate Limiting
impact: Third-party LLM APIs throttle concurrent requests during high-volume document question answering.
mitigation_strategy: Configured exponential backoff with jitter and circuit breaker (ProviderRateLimitError HTTP 429 Retry-After).

title: Single-Node SQLite Concurrency in Development
impact: Concurrent write transactions in development mode may cause lock contention.
mitigation_strategy: Enabled WAL mode; production architecture specifies PostgreSQL with row-level tenant locking; idempotency store prevents race conditions.

title: OCR Processing Latency on CPU
impact: Heavy scanned documents require significant CPU cycles for OCR processing.
mitigation_strategy: Background job queue isolates long-running OCR tasks from interactive API requests with durable state recovery.

title: Cross-Tenant Information Disclosure
impact: Multi-tenant document repository might leak evidence chunks or facts between tenants.
mitigation_strategy: Enforced pre-retrieval tenant ID filtering, strict AuthGuard deny-by-default, and comprehensive negative IDOR test suite.

title: Hallucinated Answers and Unverified Citations
impact: Generative model might assert ungrounded facts or hallucinate source references.
mitigation_strategy: AnswerGenerator strictly validates every citation span against retrieved text and forces safe abstention when grounding is absent.
